name: multi_air_carry_pays_two_discrete_touches_where_consecutive_pays_per_step
description: The car flies level at 1500 uu/s into the floating ball and pushes it: contact on 18 consecutive steps (frames 8-25). MultiAirTouch counts a touch at most once per 0.5 s: frame 8 is the 1st (0.1), frames 9-15 are inside 0.5 s and pay nothing, frame 16 is the 2nd (0.4), and by the time a 3rd would fall due (frame 24) the pushed ball has sunk under 150 uu, which ends the chain, so the whole carry pays 0.1 + 0.4 = 0.5 (+25.0 at weight 50), in two lumps and never refunded. ConsecutiveAirTouch pays smoothly per contact step (cumulative 0.1993 by frame 10, 0.4699 by frame 12, peak +0.78 = +31 weighted at 40, after its softness / car-height / distance factors) and gives it back on landing, netting -0.0406. The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose (a ball set with exactly zero velocity in the air floats: see tools/reward_lab/README.md). Verified independently: a separate script that re-implements the touch counting (ball above 150, car above 300, 0.5 s spacing, 1.0 s timeout, ball landing reset) on the exported flags reproduces every Multi payment exactly. The car has no boost, so the boost multiplier removes every bonus and only the base tiers 0.1 / 0.4 / 0.7 are paid.

expect.intent: the car keeps touching the ball from frame 8 to 25
frame 8: the first counted touch pays 0.1
frames 9-15 are inside the 0.5 s minimum spacing and pay nothing
no third touch: the ball sank under 150 uu, which ends the chain
Consecutive: cumulative 0.4699 by frame 12 (per contact step)
Consecutive: the whole carry nets -0.0406 after the landing refund
